coordinates.object_orientation: Head -Y, tail +Y, up +Z. Neutral quadrupedal stance.

concept.reason: Original specimen photographs and CT tail geometry available, no extra concept needed.

scope: Whole small armoured quadruped with flattened blade-edged tail weapon; not isolated tail and not Ankylosaurus club.
specimen_basis: CPAP-3165, mostly complete skeleton; posterior half articulated, anterior elements partly disarticulated. Soto-Acuña et al. 2021 original author preprint Fig1 real skeletal elements and tail photograph; Fig2 CT segmentation.

scale.basis: Original paper diagnosis 1.8–2.0 m, use midpoint as reconstruction target, not exact measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Small low broad armoured quadruped with slender limbs, rounded beaked head and short neck.
Short tail with seven paired lateral osteoderm units; distal five pairs fused into flattened frond-like blade, first two pairs remain recognizably separate.
Tail weapon tapers distally with broad central pairs, gently scalloped/pentagonal sides and flat low profile, not spherical club or four long Stegosaurus spikes.
Sparse low dorsal osteoderms and pelvic shield; exact dorsal placement speculative, do not add enormous shoulder or neck spikes.
uncertainties: Position of dorsal osteoderms in original skeletal reconstruction is expressly speculative.
Head shape partly reconstructed; skull depth versus width not established from preserved fragments.
Soft tissue, palette and skin details artistic; no exaggerated giant dinosaur scale.
Tiny distal knobs may represent eighth pair; optional subtle knobs only, do not label them a proven eighth full blade pair.
acceptance_checks: Seven paired tail blade units visible in top view; tail continuous and connected.
Five distal pairs form coherent plate rather than floating spikes; first two pairs distinct.
Four feet support body, slender limbs retain clearance.
Broad low armour and short neck; no terminal ball club.
Four default views, no extra concepts.
handoff_contract: Same localdir prep to maker to QA. COMPLETE includes fixedhash, maker stops. Root asynchronous backup, retain local for integration; maker does not upload or clean.

appearance_profile.palette_basis: Artistic subdued olive, sand and ochre
appearance_profile.origin: Identity root at contact footprint center, metre scale
appearance_profile.render: Exact delivered GLB, Blender Cycles CPU, Standard/None; four canonical views, perspective reused as preview
